accessories_to_curios.configuration.brid: Server and common compatibility bridge settings
accessories_to_curios.configuration.clie: Client UI, keybind, and rendering bridge settings
accessories_to_curios.configuration.disa: Redirect server-side requests opening the Accessories menu to the Curios menu.
accessories_to_curios.configuration.auto: Automatically detect used Accessories slots and register/bind them into Curios.
accessories_to_curios.configuration.migr: Automatically migrate equipped items, cosmetics, and persistent slot modifiers from pre-bridge Accessories saves into Curios.
accessories_to_curios.configuration.cust: Custom slot mapping overrides in the format accessories_slot=curios_slot (e.g. shoes=feet).
accessories_to_curios.configuration.hide: Remove the Accessories button from survival/creative inventory screens and omit registering its standalone keymapping.
accessories_to_curios.configuration.redi: Redirect Client Open Action to Curios
Redirect client-side calls opening the Accessories screen to open the Curios screen.
accessories_to_curios.configuration.enab: Allow genuine Accessories items without a custom 3D renderer to use Accessories' DefaultAccessoryRenderer.
